purpose: Teach: 残高/納税/人件/同行/職種/命じ/多額/持ち出し

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 人件費の上振れ、今期残高に多額の影響だね。
lines.en: The personnel-cost overrun is going to have a significant impact on our bottom line this quarter.
lines.style: Clipped, professional opening. Eyes on the numbers, not the problem. Steady pace, no inflection—this is fact, not concern. Brief trailing acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経理同行で財務会議に出ました。
lines.en: Yes. I sat in on the finance meeting with the accounting department.
lines.style: Straightforward confirmation. Light emphasis on 「attended」—showing he was there, did the work. No elaboration. Professional but present.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 納税までに、職種ごとの試算を出してほしい。
lines.en: I need role-by-role cost projections before we file taxes.
lines.style: Shift to directive. Clear, measured authority without sharpness. Each phrase lands with quiet weight. Pause-for-acknowledgment at the end.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。役員も命じています、社外への持ち出し厳禁と。
lines.en: Yes. The executives have also made it clear: absolutely no sharing this outside the company.
lines.style: Reinforcing now, not new information. Slight emphasis on 「ordered」—the weight from above. Careful, controlled tone. Information delivered, not defended.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.en: Make sure every department hears about it too.
lines.style: Final instruction, quieter than the last. Not urgent, but non-negotiable. Soft close, as if already looking to the next thing.
